tools.name: get_cut_to_size_quote
tools.description: Instant price for a custom-cut plastic panel. Requires a PIM SKU (get one from search_products). Returns the cut-to-size price including any machine/cutting fees, ex- and inc-GST (AUD).

shape.description: Optional cut shape: rectangle (default), circle, ring, hexagon, archway, parallelogram, star.

tools.name: get_shipping_quote
tools.description: Live freight quotes for the items currently in the cart, to an Australian suburb + postcode. Returns the cheapest option and all services. Items must already be in the cart (add them on the site first).

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Perspex Online catalogue of cut-to-size plastics (acrylic/Perspex, polycarbonate, HDPE, PVC, nylon, acetal, PTFE and more). Returns matching products and priced variants with their SKU, name, price and product-page URL. Use this first to get a SKU before pricing a cut.

query.description: Free text, e.g. '6mm clear acrylic', 'polycarbonate sheet', 'nylon rod 20mm'.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Return the current shopping cart: each line item's description, unit price (ex-GST) and quantity, plus the subtotal (ex-GST) and the GST-inclusive total in AUD.
